import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(["git", "reset", "--hard", "base"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("RESET:", result.stdout, result.stderr)
result = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--short"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("STATUS:", result.stdout)
